title: The Trip to 7-Catleven
staging:
Scene 04 — The Trip to 7-Catleven

03:05–04:00 · 55 sec · District 7 streets

Trixie and Byte leave the hideout and walk through the dirty slums. Crowds of worried cats rush toward stores. A small argument breaks out over a can of tuna.

Shots: Street-wide tracking → close-up of desperate shoppers → Trixie and Byte walking → storefront reveal.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: That queue was not here ten minutes ago. They have not even opened the second till.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: You think there's really a shortage?

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: I think someone wants us to believe there is.

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: Look at them. Everyone heard the same warning and ran for the same shelf.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Civilian cat
lines.text: Please. That is the last tin. My little one has not eaten.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: Hey. There is room for both of you. Fighting each other will not fill the freezer.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: The board says fresh delivery this morning. Why are they already rationing it?
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: Photograph that notice. Let us see what changed inside.
lines.origin: new production draft v003; not yet recorded
lines.timing_basis: estimate at 150 words/minute; replace after recording
